Jaishankar to represent India at 81st UN General Assembly

External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar will lead the Indian delegation at the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) in New York. He is scheduled to present India's position during the general debate on September 26. His visit will also include participation in several multilateral and bilateral meetings.
